subject.title: [Security] Path traversal risk in media understanding file caching middleware

question: Does a current-main trace from an untrusted inbound attachment identifier to a local media write exist outside the existing canonical-root containment checks?
rationale: The report could describe a high-impact host filesystem boundary, but its named implementation files do not align with the documented surface and the available evidence cannot safely establish coverage or exploitability.
